t: This is Commercial Road, a long street in Tower Hamlets, in London's East End. It runs about 1.9 miles from Gardiner's Corner, through Stepney, to the junction with Burdett Road in Limehouse, where it splits into the East India Dock Road and the West India Dock Road. It works as an artery linking the City of London with Canary Wharf, and it forms part of the A13. The photojournalist James Jarché was born here, in 1890 or 1891, depending on the source.
